[{"insert":"Hinge, Back & Bicep Conditioning

This piece keeps your hinge, back, and biceps working with your heart rate up. The short rests between moves are on purpose, so you keep each rep clean while still pushing the pace. Start light, around 26 to 35 pounds, and add weight each set only if your form holds. Think of it as your Strength Balance work with a higher heart rate.
"}]
